item.title: The December Checklist: 16 Small Activities for a Gentler Month
item.dc:creator: Margaret Cole
item.description: Sixteen small activities across four weeks of December. Do the ones you like, skip the ones you don’t.
item.content:encoded:
December has a way of filling up before it even starts. Gifts, plans, deadlines, and somewhere in there, the month itself.

So this is the opposite of a to-do list: sixteen small activities, four a week, and none of them are required. Do the ones you like, skip the ones you don’t, and come back whenever you want. Almost everything on it is free, and nothing on it costs much.

Week 1: Dec 1–7 (settle in)

  • Light a candle
  • Put up something festive (even one thing)
  • Make a December playlist
  • Make your space cozy with what you already have

Week 2: Dec 8–14 (the fun part)

  • Walk through a holiday market or a decorated street
  • Drink something seasonal
  • Watch a holiday movie
  • Bake or cook something warm

Week 3: Dec 15–21 (get it done)

  • Finish gifts and cards
  • Clear your inbox and your camera roll
  • Do a mini reset of your space
  • Plan your days off

Week 4: Dec 22–31 (wind down)

  • Write down one good thing from each month of 2026
  • Pull a few cards from the December reflection
  • Rest on purpose
  • Choose one word or feeling for next year

Which one are you doing first? Tell me in the comments.

Want to tick them off as you go? There’s an interactive version of this checklist on the VIRI website: vitalityritual.org/read/december-checklist.
